exposure: combined use of vacuum and forceps
outcome: neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) admission rates
abnormal neurodevelopmental outcomes (communication, personal-social, fine motor, problem-solving, gross motor skills)
cohort: The study included 390 neonates born at >=35 weeks' gestation via instrumental vaginal delivery.
finding: Instrumental vaginal delivery carries risks of birth injuries and neurodevelopmental challenges, with the combined use of vacuum and forceps being an independent risk factor for both birth injuries and abnormal neurodevelopmental outcomes.
mod_finding: The combined use of vacuum and forceps was more frequently associated with birth injuries and was an independent risk factor for abnormal neurodevelopmental outcomes compared to single instrument use.
